question: If $F(x)$ is an antiderivative of $f(x)$, what is the value of $\frac{d}{dx} \left( \int_a^x f(t) dt \right)$?
explanation:
By the First Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

$\frac{d}{dx}\left(\int_a^x f(t)dt\right)=f(x)$.

Hence the correct answer is $f(x)$.
